This position provides technical expertise in database architecture, data integrity, backup and recovery, performance optimization, and database security to ensure the availability, reliability, and efficient operation of critical business data. The Database Administrator reports to the Chief Technology Officer of the Informatics Research Institute. This is an on-site position in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Duties and Responsibilities: Provide primary database architectural and administrative support (Data Modeling, Attribution, Referential Integrity, and Database Security). Evaluate, and recommend changes to the database environment based on analysis of the monitoring effort. Oversee the physical database design including physical file characteristics, backup and recovery requirements, security requirements and physical space requirements dictated by the database design. Supervise the installation and testing of DBMS software; create and manage database objects – schemas, views, tables, stored procedures, triggers, partitioning, cluster, and indexing strategies. Provide the audit ability of the database to ensure data integrity, detection of missing data, late transaction reporting, and untimely error correction. Evaluate and complete conversion from one database to another database (structure and data). Conduct backup and recovery via Image Copy, Flashcopy, etc.; reorganize databases. Conduct performance monitoring and tuning. Perform additional duties as assigned. Qualifications: Required Qualifications: Three (3) plus years advanced DBA experience primarily focused on MS SQL Server. Experience should include routine maintenance, managing user permissions, running backups; writing, debugging, and optimizing complex SQL queries; and database migrations. Five (5) plus years’ experience with T-SQL, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), and database maintenance plans. Five (5) plus years’ experience with Microsoft SQL Server. A Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or related. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge and experience with DB2, Oracle, ADABAS, Microsoft Access, PostgreSQL, and VSAM. A graduate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems (MIS), or related. Experience working on a development team. Experience with client engagements on design, delivery, deployment and on-going maintenance. Previous experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment.
